Find the GCD (HCF) of two numbers using the Euclidean algorithm.

Supplied answer
a = int(input("Enter first number: "))
b = int(input("Enter second number: "))
x, y = a, b
while y != 0:
    x, y = y, x % y
print("GCD =", x)
# import math; print(math.gcd(a, b)) # built-in shortcut
Note: Euclid: keep replacing (x, y) with (y, x % y) until y becomes 0.
